brand.beakbound.note: Stays in Latin letters; isolate as a left-to-right run inside Arabic text (BEAKBOUND in the logo).

brand.beak1-code.note: Technical token, never changed; only the sentence around it is translated.

char.pip.note: Transliteration of Pip; masculine (agreement and self-reference).

char.peaches.note: Transliteration (Pee-chiz); feminine. Her fruit puns use خوخ (peach), the pan-Arab word.

char.minty.note: Transliteration; masculine. Mint jokes use نعناع (mint) and the colour «بلون النعناع»; the name itself is not the Arabic word for mint, so «named after me» jokes become colour jokes.

char.orbit.note: Transliteration with one kasra so TTS says Or-bit (not «awrabat»); UI may drop the kasra. Feminine. The word orbit (مدار) is not used as her name.

char.postmaster-bill.note: Title before the name, as in Arabic; short form بيل.

char.courier.note: Short form الساعي. Grammatically masculine generic in shared lines and in what bosses say to the courier (CHARACTERS.md rule for Arabic); Peaches and Orbit may say ساعية البريد about themselves.

char.narrator.note: Never named on screen; captions in a calm storybook voice.

boss.baron-bat.note: وطواط = bat (as in الرجل الوطواط, Batman); the doubled «wat-wat» gives the name a ring in place of the B-B alliteration. Short form البارون, address يا بارون. The small enemy bats use the plain word خفاش/خفافيش.

boss.spitter-king.note: بصّاق = one who spits, same word as the beetles (خنفساء بصّاقة). Bill says أيها الملك; birds say يا صاحب الجلالة.

boss.dusk-empress.note: غسق = dusk, same word as her moths (فراشة الغسق). Short form الإمبراطورة; Pip says صاحبة السموّ.

boss.pirate-captain.note: Short form القبطان, which he also uses for himself.

boss.ember-dragon.note: جمر = embers (same root as his جمرات attack). Short form التنين; the letter opens «عزيزي التنين».

guardian.neferhoo.note: Kasras guide TTS to NEF-er-hoo; keep the same spelling everywhere (UI may drop the marks if the font renders them poorly).

guardian.king-coo.note: كوكو = the pigeon's coo as children say it; short and card-friendly. His card shout COO! = كوو!. He calls himself المفوّض.

guardian.searchlight-gargoyle.note: غرغول = gargoyle (loanword), كشّاف = searchlight. Card split: big «الغرغول» with small «الكشّاف» (order may follow the layout). Short form الغرغول, also his self-reference.

npc.firefly-nursery.note: حضانة = a crèche for small children, not a plant nursery.

npc.drum-captain.note: Band leader; deliberately not قبطان (the Pirate Captain).

npc.statue-carver.note: Singular; «his nose» = the statue's nose (أنف التمثال).

npc.pyramid-caretaker.note: Feminine (she says the dust talks back). Short form الحارسة.

npc.night-cabbies.note: Cargo form after a preposition: سائقي الأجرة الليليين (same people as «night-shift cabbies»).

npc.lighthouse-keeper.note: Feminine to match the female voice (Jessie); the English term is neutral.

npc.kite-flyers.note: Plural; cargo names the beach festival (مهرجان الشاطئ).

npc.storm-watch.note: Cargo form: بحّارة مراقبة العواصف (storm-watch sailors), same people.

npc.polar-station.note: A place speaking for its crew.

npc.noodle-chef.note: نودلز is the common loanword; the sign is «مفتوح».

npc.sphinx.note: The Arabic name of the Sphinx of Giza; masculine. Peaches: «سيد أبو الهول». After a preposition: أبي الهول.

npc.unit-7.note: Spoken «الوحدة سبعة». Its thank-you is clipped and robotic (no letter case in Arabic).

title.brewer-of-the-swarm.note: Adapted: «alchemist of the swarm» says brewer better than a literal طبّاخ (cook) and fits the mad-alchemist; السرب = his beetles.

title.keeper-of-the-lost-letter.note: أمين (keeper/curator) instead of حارس so the GUARDIAN card (حارس) does not repeat the word; singular.

title.keeper-of-lost-letters.note: Plural job title, echoes his card epithet.

title.royal-courier.note: Same courier word: Pip «ساعي البريد الملكي؟ أنا مجرد ساعي بريد. ساعي البريد بيب.»

title.commissioner-of-the-curb.note: رصيف = pavement/curb where pigeons peck; pompous police title.

title.commissioner.note: Police commissioner; third person «المفوّض يقبل العرض»; address «حضرة المفوّض».

title.watchman-of-the-tallest-tower.note: رقيب = watchman; avoids حارس (GUARDIAN) on the same card.

region.ancient-arabia.note: Neutral, storybook historical form (Arabian Nights mood), not a modern country.

region.antarctica.note: Short label (القارة القطبية الجنوبية is too long for the map).

region.cyberpunk-city.note: Bill also says مدينة النيون (the neon city).

place.city-of-light.note: The usual Arabic epithet for Paris.

place.edge-of-the-map.note: Same words as the chapter and the achievement.

place.sugarloaf-mountain.note: Keeps «sugar», so Pip's «not actually made of sugar» joke survives.

place.theatre-marquee.note: سقيفة = awning/shelter over the door: the cart sheltered under it. Not مظلة, which is the umbrellas of 3-2.

place.tallest-tower.note: Same words as the cargo and رقيب أعلى برج.

place.canopy.note: The roof of leaves; same words as the chapter.

chapter.canopy-route.note: خط = the club's word for a mail route.

chapter.lamplight-line.note: Keeps the lamp image and the «line».

level.1-5.note: Same words as Neferhoo's EXPRESS POST.

level.1-7.note: مبيت = where one sleeps the night (a roost).

level.2-1.note: Same road word as الطريق القديم.

level.3-1.note: Moths drawn to light (cf. the Arabic image of the moth and the flame).

level.3-2.note: Echoes the Arabic title of «Singin' in the Rain» (الغناء تحت المطر); keeps wheels + rain.

level.3-4.note: Same words as the Gargoyle's STORM WARNING banner.

level.4-4.note: Fatha/sukun so الجزر reads «low tide», not carrots or islands.

level.4-5.note: Spring tide as «the highest tide» (not the season).

level.5-7.note: Arabic idiom for the final stretch.

cargo.1-2.en: Star charts for the sloth stargazer

cargo.1-4.en: Feather boas for the carnival parade

cargo.1-5.en: A rush invitation for the drum captain

cargo.1-6.en: Cocoa beans for the temple cooks

cargo.1-7.en: A sundial for the dawn keeper

cargo.1-8.en: A final notice for Baron Bat

cargo.2-2.en: A new chisel for the statue carver

cargo.2-3.en: Water buckets for the fire brigade

cargo.2-4.en: A book of new riddles for the Sphinx

cargo.2-5.en: A telescope for the pyramid astronomer

cargo.2-6.en: A feather duster for the caretaker

cargo.2-7.en: Lamp oil for the lantern sellers

cargo.2-8.en: Water flasks for the long caravan

cargo.2-9.en: A stop-brewing order for the Spitter King

cargo.3-1.en: Light bulbs for the theatre marquee

cargo.3-3.en: Hot pretzels for the night-shift cabbies

cargo.3-4.en: A weather vane for the tallest tower

cargo.3-6.en: Sheet music for the accordion player

cargo.3-8.en: A wake-up call for the Dusk Empress
cargo.3-8.note: جرس إنذار = an alarm bell and, figuratively, a warning: both meanings of wake-up call.

cargo.4-1.en: A new lens for the lighthouse keeper

cargo.4-2.en: Oven mitts for the volcano baker

cargo.4-3.en: Kite string for the beach festival

cargo.4-4.en: A reply for the island hermit

cargo.4-5.en: A tide table for the ferry crew

cargo.4-6.en: Fish biscuits for the gull colony

cargo.4-7.en: Dry socks for the storm-watch sailors

cargo.4-8.en: A return-the-mail order for the Captain

cargo.5-1.en: Woolly hats for the penguin choir

cargo.5-2.en: Hot cocoa for the polar station

cargo.5-3.en: Spare fuses for the noodle bar sign

cargo.5-4.en: A paper letter for a curious robot

cargo.5-5.en: Race tickets for the rooftop runners

cargo.5-8.en: The first letter ever sent to the Dragon

enemy.purple-bat.note: Plain bat word خفاش (plural خفافيش) for all small bats; only the Baron's name uses وطواط.

enemy.spitter-beetle.note: Same بصّاق as the Spitter King. Plural خنافس.

enemy.dusk-moth.note: فراشة (moth/butterfly) is warmer for children than عثّة; plural فراشات.

enemy.squadron.note: فرقة (police squad), not سرب, which is the Swarm.

enemy.straggler.note: UI: «تعود!» (comes back), ALL CAUGHT! = «قُبض على الجميع!».

enemy.brood.note: He calls them «يا جعاريني الصغار» (scarabs) and «يا مساعديّ!».

enemy.swarm-bats.note: Same سرب as the Swarm rush.

attack.screech.note: Short صرخة; Bill's «He's all screech» = «كلّه صراخ» (same root).

attack.fan.note: Fan-shaped spread; fans of three = مراوح من ثلاث.

attack.veil.note: silk shield = درع حريري; FIRE WHEN THE VEIL DROPS = «ارمِ حين يسقط الوشاح».

attack.dragon-breath.note: نفث (blowing fire) avoids نفس, which TTS could read as «soul».

attack.lamp.note: Same word as the city lamps (allowed); LAMP OPEN = «المصباح مفتوح».

attack.mail-call.note: «Mail call» as the moment mail is handed out; Neferhoo shouts «توزيع البريد!».

attack.ankh.note: The usual Arabic name of the ankh (عنخ is the scholarly word).

hazard.switchback.note: Plural منعطفات: «اصعد من فتحة، وانزل من التالية».

hazard.steam-geyser.note: Plural فتحات; hot ones = الساخنة, soft ones = اللطيفة.

hazard.tide.note: HIGH TIDE = «مدّ عالٍ», TIDE RISING = «المدّ يرتفع».

set-piece.gale.note: Banner «ريح عاتية!»; open side = الجهة المفتوحة.

set-piece.vanguard.note: Here they come! = «ها هم قادمون!»; CLEAR! = «خلا الطريق!».

pickup.star.note: Plural نجوم; same word for the pickup, the rating and the wallet.

pickup.heart.note: Plural قلوب; keeps Peaches's love puns.

weapon.shoot.note: The bird throws rocks, so «throw» is the natural button word; «Tap Shoot» = «انقر على ارمِ»; shoot down = أسقِط.

weapon.rock.note: Plural حجارة; pebble = حصاة. Out of rocks = «نفدت الحجارة».

weapon.ammo.note: The birds say الحجارة; Reloading… = «إعادة التعبئة…».

mode.endless.note: endless sky = السماء التي لا تنتهي.

mode.push-up-flight.note: Push-up = تمرين الضغط; a side mini game.

ui.sky-club-post.note: Also the courier's greeting at every door: «بريد نادي السماء!».

ui.passport-stamp.note: Ink stamp; postage stamps are طوابع. The wax flame seal is ختم اللهب (always with اللهب).

ui.records-screen.note: The club's ledgers are الدفاتر, to keep them apart.

ui.postcard.note: Dear courier, = «عزيزي ساعي البريد،»; P.S. = «ملاحظة:»; Greetings from = «تحيات من».

ui.guardian.note: One word everywhere (Bill: «لا ختم لهب على هذا الحارس»).

ui.delivered.note: No gender or number agreement needed; the birds shout it too.

ui.bonk.note: Cartoon bump sound; the same sound as the Empress's «طُق. طُق.».

ui.to-be-continued.note: The usual Arabic TV formula; the narrator's caption starts with exactly «يُتبَع…».

ui.pause.note: Idiom for «take a breather»; Retry = «أعد المحاولة», Keep flying = «تابع الطيران».

ui.pace.note: Relaxed = هادئ, Steady = ثابت, Brisk = سريع.

ui.lane.note: open lane = المسار المفتوح (route is خط, lane is مسار).

ui.home-greeting.note: Works for any bird and any player (no gendered «ready» adjective).

achievement.flock-together.note: From the proverb «إنّ الطيور على أشكالها تقع» (birds of a feather flock together).

achievement.out-of-the-spotlight.note: The Arabic idiom also means «out of the limelight»: both senses kept.

story.flame-seal.note: A wax seal; alone «ختم», plural «أختام». «a seal shaped like a flame» = «ختمٌ على شكل لهب».

story.warm-letter.note: دافئة is both literally warm and kind; «warm as toast» = «دافئة كرغيف خرج من الفرن».

story.mail-route.note: Short خط, plural خطوط: chapter names, boss lines, Bill.

story.beacon.note: A signal fire (شعلة) rather than منارة, which is the lighthouse of 4-1.

story.the-books.note: «I checked the books twice» = «راجعتُ الدفاتر مرتين».

story.pigeonholes.note: Pun adapted: Bill says the post «never had a carrier pigeon» (الحمام الزاجل, the classic Arabic mail bird). See NOTES.

story.bagel.note: كعك (sesame ring bread) is the closest familiar bread to a bagel.

story.brew.note: «brewing» = يطبخ/يغلي; SOMETHING IS BREWING = «شيءٌ ما يُطبَخ».

story.perfect-ink.note: ink that never fades = حبر لا يبهت أبدًا.

story.letter-phrases.note: Get Well Soon = «الشفاء العاجل», Love From = «مع حبي»: the stock phrases of Arabic cards and letters.

story.postage-stamp.note: Singular طابع; stamp collector = جامع طوابع.

story.lamps.note: Street lamps; no near-homophone risk in Arabic.

story.first-letter.en: the first letter ever sent to the Dragon

story.dotted-i.en: He dotted his “i” with a tiny bat.
story.dotted-i.target: وجعل نقطة الباء في توقيعه وطواطًا صغيرًا
story.dotted-i.note: Adapted: Arabic letters have dots too; the Baron turned the dot of the ب in «البارون» into a tiny bat.

story.headwear.note: flask crown = تاج القارورة, diadem = الإكليل, hat = القبعة, police cap = قبعة الشرطة, brow visor = واقي الجبين.

story.kindling.note: «Your letters are kindling» = «رسائلك ليست إلا حطبًا».

story.rush-hour.note: «His bedtime is our rush hour» = «فوقت نومه هو ساعة ذروتنا».

motto.every-letter-lands.note: Short, works as a question: «هل تصل كل رسالة حقًا؟»; «Every letter lands, and mine lands FAST!» = «كل رسالة تصل، ورسالتي تصل بسرعة البرق!».

address.rookie.note: Masculine generic (Arabic rule in CHARACTERS.md); Pip about himself: «ساعي البريد المبتدئ بيب».

address.darling.note: The Gargoyle and the Baron (masculine generic). Peaches uses gender-free endearments instead (see pet names).

address.postie.note: The Captain's clipped, slangy form of ساعي البريد.

address.sprat.note: A sardine: the small fry; a noun epithet, so it fits any bird.

address.matey.note: Old-sailor «O companion»; me hearties = «يا بحّارتي الأشدّاء», me handsome = «يا وسيم».

address.lad.note: Gender trap avoided: the story's «lad» uses the neutral pirate epithet.

address.small-one.note: messenger = «يا حامل الرسائل» (not رسول, which also means prophet); little bird = «أيها الطائر الصغير».

address.little-one.note: little wanderer = «أيها الجوّال الصغير», night bird = «يا طائر الليل», little ruffian = «أيها المشاغب الصغير».

address.old-courier.note: Respectful-tender («ancient», not «old» in a blunt sense).

address.partner.note: buddy = يا صديقي, pal = يا صاحبي, hotshot = يا بطل.

address.peaches-pet-names.note: Gender-free noun endearments, never the same twice: يا عسل، يا سكّر، يا روحي، يا قلبي، يا زهرتي، يا كعكتي، يا قطعة الحلوى، يا قمر، يا ظريف (to a bat).

address.bossy.note: Ironic «boss» (الزعيم is the game's boss word).

address.minions.en: Cousins! / my lovelies / my little scarabs / me hearties
address.minions.target: يا أقاربي! / يا حلواتي / يا جعاريني الصغار / يا بحّارتي الأشدّاء
address.minions.note: Baron: «يا أقاربي!», «يا صغاري»; Empress: «يا حلواتي», «يا جميلاتي»; Spitter King: «يا مساعديّ!», «يا جعاريني الصغار», «أيتها الخنافس!»; Captain: «كل الأيدي على السطح!», «يا طاقمي!»; Dragon: «يا خفافيشي», «يا ظلال السماء الحمراء».

phrase.baron-bat-line.en: This route is my roost now, little courier!
phrase.baron-bat-line.target: هذا الخط صار غرفة نومي يا ساعي البريد الصغير!
phrase.baron-bat-line.note: Card line = story clip before-1-8-4, word for word.

phrase.spitter-king-line.en: Every letter on my road goes in the brew!
phrase.spitter-king-line.target: كل رسالة على طريقي تذهب إلى الخلطة!

phrase.dusk-empress-line.en: Hush now. The night mail is sleeping.
phrase.dusk-empress-line.target: صه الآن. بريد الليل يغطّ في نومه.

phrase.pirate-captain-line.en: Arr! Every mailbag on these waves be mine!
phrase.pirate-captain-line.target: أرر! كل كيس بريد على هذه الأمواج ملكي!

phrase.ember-dragon-line.en: The sky is mine. Your letters are kindling.
phrase.ember-dragon-line.target: السماء ملكي أنا. ورسائلك ليست إلا حطبًا.

phrase.neferhoo-line.en: Return to sender! This route has a courier.
phrase.neferhoo-line.target: يُعاد إلى المُرسِل! لهذا الخط ساعي بريده.

phrase.king-coo-line.en: Nobody flies till the bread cart is found!
phrase.king-coo-line.target: لا أحد يطير حتى يُعثر على عربة الخبز!

phrase.searchlight-gargoyle-line.en: Hold still! Nobody ever stays in the light.
phrase.searchlight-gargoyle-line.target: اثبت مكانك! لا أحد يبقى في الضوء أبدًا.

phrase.return-to-sender.note: The formula Arab postal services print on returned mail; prop split «يُعاد / إلى المُرسِل». Marks: المُرسِل = sender, not المُرسَل (the sent). Hurt line: «يُعاد إلى... إليّ أنا؟».

phrase.signed-sealed-delivered.note: Three beats; Minty's twist: «موقّعة، مختومة، وطارت!».

phrase.small-bird-big-sky.note: Pip's riffs reuse the pattern: «طائر صغير، خطة كبيرة!».

phrase.peaches-tagline.en: Rosy cheeks, curly crest, all heart.
phrase.peaches-tagline.target: خدود وردية، عُرف مجعّد، وقلب كبير.

phrase.minty-tagline.en: Tiny hummer. Fresh sprig. Full speed.
phrase.minty-tagline.target: طنّان صغير. غصن نعناع. سرعة قصوى.

phrase.orbit-tagline.en: A dreamy owl who flies by starlight.
phrase.orbit-tagline.target: بومة حالمة تطير على ضوء النجوم.
phrase.orbit-tagline.note: Bill: «طِر على ضوء النجوم يا مبتدئ».

phrase.sprint-turbo-feathers.note: توربو is a known loanword; the tanween helps TTS read «rīshun».

phrase.all-screech.note: Like «كلّه كلام» (all talk); صراخ shares its root with صرخة (the screech attack).

phrase.no-flame-seal.en: No flame seal on this guardian.
phrase.no-flame-seal.target: لا ختم لهب على هذا الحارس.

phrase.mister-nice-bat.note: Twist of «انتهى زمن اللطف» (no more Mr Nice Guy).

phrase.at-your-disservice.note: Twist of the polite formula «رهنَ إشارتك» (at your service): «at your annoyance».

phrase.sticks-and-stones.note: No Arabic «sticks and stones» proverb: «talk is easy… I brought the stones», keeping the rock joke.

phrase.pirate-speak.note: Arabic stage-pirate kit: أرر! (growl), يو هو! (Ahoy; not أهوي, which TTS could read as the verb «I fall»), مكانَك! (Avast), يا لصواري سفينتي! (Shiver me timbers), يا للهول! (Blimey), شراع في الأفق! (Sail ho!), يا صاح, يا سردينة.

phrase.nobody-looks-up.note: Payoff: «كل ساعي بريد سينظر إلى الأعلى!».

phrase.accepts.note: Third person; «الغرغول يقبل العرض.» (العرض = the offer, a pompous touch).

phrase.bonk-bonk.note: Same sound word as the knockout card.

phrase.hush.note: Shh = «ششش»; Hush = «صه»; Quietly, please = «بهدوء، من فضلك».

phrase.welcome-to-the-club.note: Literal; the membership is what matters.

ui.omen-baron-returns.note: The line: «لقد عاد، وصوته أعلى بكثير…».

ui.omen-spitter.note: «Something is being cooked» also means «something is being plotted» in Arabic: the brewing pun survives. Line: «الهواء بدأ يفور…».

ui.omen-king-coo.note: Echoes مفوّض الرصيف. Line: «أحدهم غاضب جدًا بسبب عربة الخبز…».

ui.omen-gargoyle.note: Same words as level 3-4. Line: «شيء على الحافة يراقب…».

story.letter.note: Plural رسائل; same word as in the motto.

story.mail-and-post.note: One Arabic word for mail and post; postman = ساعي البريد, postmen = سعاة البريد.

story.delivery.note: deliver = يوصل/أوصل, delivered = «تم التوصيل», a delivery = توصيلة.

story.salutation.note: Dear courier, = «عزيزي ساعي البريد،» (masculine generic, standard letter form).

ui.make-yourself-at-home.note: Settings title; the Arabic hospitality idiom.

ui.switch-on-off.note: Switch state words (budget 4). Status «مفعّل / معطّل» is used for the builder's Shoot/Sprint switches.

ui.time-units.note: Short units after Western digits: «12 ث», «1 د 05 ث», «منذ 3 س». Full words with ICU plurals where the budget allows (ثانية / ثانيتان / ثوانٍ).

ui.new-best-short.note: Where «أفضل نتيجة جديدة!» (17) does not fit the 14-wide budget; the 22-wide results ribbon keeps the glossary form.

ui.duel-series.note: Head-to-head tally «المواجهات 2–1»; سلسلة stays the star streak.

ui.player-tag.note: Kept in Latin (budget 5 = one letter beside the number; no established Arabic abbreviation of اللاعب). Long forms: «اللاعب 1».

ui.stamp-band.note: Budget 10: «نادي السماء» is 11. «بريد جوي» (air mail) is the classic stamp wording. Owner may prefer another.

ui.remix-suffix.note: Suffix after a level name; the key itself is «إعادة مزج». copy suffix = «نسخة».

ui.builder-short.note: Short key for the Level Builder (صانع المراحل).

ui.builder-terms.en: Sway / As you arrive / Look / Place / Opening / Motion
ui.builder-terms.target: التأرجح / عند وصولك / الشكل / الموضع / الفتحة / الحركة
ui.builder-terms.note: Inspector captions; motion Still/Gentle/Lively = ثابتة / هادئة / نشيطة (the gate is feminine).

ui.pickups.note: Stars and hearts placed in the sky; effects «أصوات ... الجوائز».

ui.reps.note: Rep counts with full ICU plurals (ضغطتان، ضغطات، 12 ضغطة); «قرفصاء» alone where a budget is tight.

ui.key-names.en: Space, Esc, W, D, A, Up/Right/Left
ui.key-names.target: Space، Esc، W، D، A، فوق/يمين/يسار
ui.key-names.note: Letter keys keep their labels; arrow keys named in words (no ↑ glyph in the fonts).

ui.status-ready.en: READY TO FLY / YOUR CO-PILOT / FLYING
ui.status-ready.target: على أهبة الطيران / رفيق رحلتك / في الرحلة
ui.status-ready.note: Bird status pills worded without gendered adjectives (two birds are feminine).

ui.duel-beat.note: Noun phrase, so no verb agreement with the winner's gender.
